nodes.description: Pionaut.mint(uint256 amount) payable: checks saleOpen, payment, per-address limit and publicSaleLimit, then loops randomPickId + internalMint and finally increments MintAmountPerPublicAddress[msg.sender] and publicSaleMinted.

Pionaut.mintForWhiteList(uint256 amount) payable: checks payment, whiteListOpen, whitelist total limit and per-address whitelist allowance, loops randomPickId + internalMint, then increments whitelistMinted and whitelistTotalMinted after the loop.

Pionaut.airdrop(uint256 amount) whenNotPaused free mint: checks airdropOpen, total airdrop limit and per-address airdrop allowance, loops randomPickId + internalMint, then increments airdropMinted and airdropTotalMinted after the loop.

Pionaut.randomPickId() internal view: pseudo-random token id from keccak256(block.difficulty, block.timestamp, loopCount) modulo MaxSupply; loops until an unminted id is found and requires totalSupply() < MaxSupply.

Pionaut.internalMint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal: calls _safeMint(to, tokenId) which transfers control to the recipient contract via onERC721Received before the caller's accounting is finished.
Pionaut.withdraw() onlyOwner: reads contract balance and sends balance*mintSplitFeePercent/totalFeeUnitPercent to mintSplitFeeWallet via transfer.
Pionaut.safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId, string _tokenURI) onlyOwner: owner mint that calls internalMint, records nftMinters[tokenId]=msg.sender and optionally sets the token URI.
Pionaut._beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) whenNotPaused override hook invoked on every mint/transfer/burn inside ERC721.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as minter key, whitelist/airdrop lookup key and ERC721 recipient.
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable value consumed by randomPickId randomness.

External call performed by ERC721._safeMint: IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) executed before mint accounting is completed, allowing recipient contract reentrancy.
Weak pseudo-randomness: token id derived from block.timestamp and block.difficulty via keccak256, both predictable/influenceable by the block producer.
ETH transfer via payable(mintSplitFeeWallet).transfer((balance * mintSplitFeePercent) / totalFeeUnitPercent) in withdraw.
uint256 publicSaleMinted: global counter of public sale mints, incremented after the mint loop in mint().
mapping(address => uint256) MintAmountPerPublicAddress: per-address public mint counter, read at start and written after the loop in mint().
mapping(address => uint256) whitelistMinted: per-address whitelist mint counter, written after the loop in mintForWhiteList().
uint256 whitelistTotalMinted: global whitelist mint counter, incremented after the loop in mintForWhiteList().
mapping(address => uint256) airdropMinted: per-address airdrop counter, written after the loop in airdrop().
uint256 airdropTotalMinted: global airdrop mint counter, incremented after the loop in airdrop().
bool saleOpen: gate for the public mint function.
uint256 price: mint price used in msg.value >= price * amount checks.
uint256 publicSaleLimitPerAddress: per-address public mint cap.
uint256 MaxSupply: maximum token id bound used by randomPickId modulo arithmetic.
mapping(uint256 => address) nftMinters: records the minter (msg.sender) of each token id.
address mintSplitFeeWallet: recipient of the ETH transferred in withdraw().
uint256 mintSplitFeePercent: numerator used in the withdraw fee computation.
uint256 totalFeeUnitPercent: denominator used in the withdraw fee computation.
bool airdropOpen: gate for the airdrop function.
bool whiteListOpen: gate for the whitelist mint function.
uint256 publicSaleLimit: global public sale cap checked in mint().
uint256 airdropMintTotalLimt: global airdrop cap checked in airdrop().
uint256 whitelistMintTotalLimit: global whitelist cap checked in mintForWhiteList().
uint256 amount parameter present in mint(), mintForWhiteList() and airdrop(); controls loop iteration count and per-transaction mint volume.
uint256 tokenId local variable inside the mint loops of mint(), mintForWhiteList() and airdrop().
uint256 randomId/temp/loopCount local variables inside randomPickId().
uint256 balance local variable in withdraw() holding address(this).balance.

edges.reason: msg.sender keys MintAmountPerPublicAddress and identifies the caller of mint().
msg.sender is the whitelist lookup key in mintForWhiteList().
msg.sender is the airdroplist lookup key in airdrop().
msg.sender is passed as the recipient to internalMint(msg.sender, tokenId).
nftMinters[tokenId] is set to msg.sender in mint/mintForWhiteList/airdrop/safeMint.
mint() loops over amount calling internalMint for each token.
mint() calls randomPickId() to choose each token id.
mintForWhiteList() loops calling internalMint.
mintForWhiteList() calls randomPickId().
airdrop() loops calling internalMint.
airdrop() calls randomPickId().
internalMint calls _safeMint which performs the onERC721Received external call to the recipient.
A malicious ERC721 receiver can reenter mint() from onERC721Received before publicSaleMinted and MintAmountPerPublicAddress are updated.
A malicious receiver can reenter mintForWhiteList() before whitelist counters are updated.
A malicious receiver can reenter airdrop() before airdrop counters are updated.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 pseudo-random selection in randomPickId().
randomPickId depends on block.timestamp and block.difficulty, allowing miner/validator influence over which token id is minted.
mint() writes MintAmountPerPublicAddress[msg.sender] after the mint loop completes.
mint() accumulates publicSaleMinted += amount after the loop, so reentrant calls can overshoot the intended accounting.
mintForWhiteList() accumulates whitelistTotalMinted += amount after the loop.
airdrop() accumulates airdropTotalMinted += amount after the loop.
airdrop() writes airdropMinted[msg.sender] after the loop.
withdraw() performs the ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
withdraw() multiplies balance by mintSplitFeePercent before dividing by totalFeeUnitPercent.
The withdraw transfer sends ETH to mintSplitFeeWallet.
safeMint() calls internalMint(to, tokenId).
safeMint() stores nftMinters[tokenId] = msg.sender.
ERC721 minting/transfer triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook which enforces whenNotPaused.
mint() reads saleOpen to gate public minting.
mintForWhiteList() reads whiteListOpen to gate whitelist minting.
airdrop() reads airdropOpen to gate free airdrops.
mint() reads price in the msg.value >= price * amount check.
mint() reads publicSaleLimitPerAddress for the per-address cap.
mint() checks publicSaleMinted + amount <= publicSaleLimit.
randomPickId requires totalSupply() < MaxSupply and modulates candidate ids by MaxSupply.
airdrop() checks airdropTotalMinted + amount <= airdropMintTotalLimt.
mintForWhiteList() checks whitelistTotalMinted + amount <= whitelistMintTotalLimit.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter is a temporary loop bound for the mint family (mint/mintForWhiteList/airdrop); it collapses into the core mint function whose loop and per-address accounting it controls.
tokenId is the per-iteration token identifier produced by randomPickId and consumed by internalMint, so it normalizes into the core internalMint function.
randomId/temp/loopCount are internal scratch values of the pseudo-random selection and normalize into the core randomPickId function.
balance is the transient address(this).balance read used only inside withdraw, so it normalizes into the core withdraw function.
